content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I'm experiencing an issue with [product_name] when trying to upload my program to the controller. The software shows: "the diagram contains contacts that aren't connected to supply. Would you like to connect them to supply now?" I programmed in ladder language, but errors are displayed in the logic editor. I don't have contacts unsupplied. Can anyone help? My program is attached in the included files.
Hello, This is a common issue when using ladder logic, which is discussed elsewhere. Try converting the program to FBD format and then download it again. Regards,
Hello [user_name], thanks for responding! Your suggestion didn’t resolve the issue. Any other ideas? This situation is frustrating.

The error message in [product_name] states blocks "AND" B084, B0... are not connected to outputs. If I connect their output to an "X block," the error message disappears. However, my controller is [article_no] version, which doesn’t support 65 "X blocks." I'm confused about why so many "AND block" outputs remain unconnected. An "AND block" without a connected output seems pointless, right? Will connecting these outputs change my program’s functionality?

Hello, I've noticed this as well. It appears that certain constructions in ladder logic can't be converted to FBD without causing errors. Since the transfer is to the device in FBD, this creates an issue. I'm unsure whether solving errors using open connectors will make the program function as intended, but your [article_no] version supports 16 open connectors. You can combine several open outputs using "AND blocks." Try simulating to see if the program works as expected. If not, rebuilding the program in FBD might be the only reliable solution. Personally, I avoid ladder logic, and many here seem to do the same. Maybe someone with more expertise has another solution. Regards,

Hi, I've reviewed the attached program. You won't be able to download this to the device. Here are my suggestions: Your ladder diagram appears correct, but I suspect you used copy/paste, which can generate function blocks unseen by the ladder editor. Try reprogramming in ladder logic and avoid copy/paste. Regularly use F2 to check the status window. As long as it indicates the device can run the program, you're fine. Hope this helps.
Hi [user_name], can you specify which version of [product_name] you're using? Let us know.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering major obstacles when uploading ladder logic programs in [product_name], particularly with hardware version [article_no]. The software is producing confusing error messages about unconnected contacts or outputs after converting ladder diagrams to FBD, preventing successful downloads. Users are unsure about the logic editor's reliability, the conversion process, and block output limitations. Feedback highlights difficulties due to hidden programming elements, ambiguous error reporting, and limited methods in the software to handle hardware-specific constraints.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect ladder logic programs to upload to the [article_no] device without conversion errors. They also want error messages in the software to be clear, accurate, and easy to address.
